name: eggd_pyTMB
title: eggd_pyTMB
summary: Calculates Tumour Mutational Burden (TMB) from an annotated VCF using pyTMB

inputSpec.name: bed
inputSpec.label: Capture BED file
inputSpec.help: Capture design BED file. Should be 0-based, sorted, and with no header.

inputSpec.name: bam
inputSpec.label: BAM file
inputSpec.help: BAM file used to compute sample-specific coverage-based effective genome size.

inputSpec.name: bam_bai
inputSpec.label: BAM index file
inputSpec.help: BAM index file (.bai) required by mosdepth for coverage computation.

inputSpec.name: vaf
inputSpec.label: Minimum variant allele frequency
inputSpec.help: Variants with VAF below this threshold are excluded. Default: 0.05.

inputSpec.name: maf
inputSpec.label: Maximum population allele frequency
inputSpec.help: Variants with population MAF above this threshold are excluded as germline. Default: 0.0001.

inputSpec.name: min_depth
inputSpec.label: Minimum total read depth
inputSpec.help: Variants with total depth below this threshold are excluded. Default: 50.

inputSpec.name: min_alt_depth
inputSpec.label: Minimum alt allele depth
inputSpec.help: Variants with fewer than this many alt reads are excluded. Default: 2.

inputSpec.name: min_coverage
inputSpec.label: Minimum coverage
inputSpec.help: Minimum coverage per region of the BED file. Default: 50.

inputSpec.name: min_mapquality
inputSpec.label: Minimum mapping quality
inputSpec.help: Minimum mapping quality threshold. Reads below this value are ignored. Default: 50.

inputSpec.name: vcf_yaml
inputSpec.label: VCF YAML configuration. Options are: tso500 or tnhaplotyper2
inputSpec.help: YAML file containing VCF annotation parameters. Options are: tso500 or tnhaplotyper2

outputSpec.name: tmb_report
outputSpec.label: TMB report
outputSpec.help: Plain-text TMB report produced by pyTMB, including TMB score, 95% CI, and filter statistics.
